Name: BigBubbleSwitchArea
Notes: An area that activates its SW_A once the player enters it while riding a Big Bubble.

Obj_arg0.Name: Deactivate Outside Area
Obj_arg0.Description: If enabled, SW_A will be disabled again after leaving the area.

Obj_arg1.Name: Negate Output?
Obj_arg1.Description: If set, SW_A will be deactivated instead.

Obj_arg2.Name: Ground Use Only? (Defunct)
Obj_arg2.Description:
Functionally disables the area.

If set, the player must be on the ground to activate SW_A. As this area is only active whilst the player is in a bubble, Mario never touches the ground and the area never activates.

SW_APPEAR.Description: Appears when this switch is activated.

SW_A.Description: Gets activated when ths player is inside the area while riding a Big Bubble.

SW_B.Description: If used, this switch needs to be activated in order to make this area manipulate SW_A.

SW_AWAKE.Description: Enables rendering and resumes updates when this switch is active.
